name: @flower-man/api
description: Flower Man REST API (NestJS from a later milestone) and database migration CLI.

scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/database/migrate.js up --dir ../../infra/database/migrations
scripts.db:migrate:status: pnpm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/database/migrate.js status --dir ../../infra/database/migrations
